request.deadline: Events scheduled for July 28-31, 2026 in Las Vegas; specific delivery deadline not otherwise stated in document
deliverables: Cardano title sponsorship of Rare Evo 2026 main stage and global livestream
Cardano title sponsorship/support for Rare Dev Gov Day 2026 on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas
Free General Admission access for the Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
Five Cardano-focused main stage panelist positions
Travel and lodging support for 20 Cardano community members
10 ARIA hotel room giveaways and 50 VIP conference pass giveaways
Tier-1 media coverage and livestream Cardano ads
Return of 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury
request.what: Cardano title sponsorship for Rare Evo 2026 main stage/global livestream and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026 sponsorship.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, valued by the proposer at $660,000 using $0.24 per ADA, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages.
The proposed budget allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, taxes, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network states it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with current VIP ticket retail value listed as $900.
Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but the proposal says funding would substantially expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and industry outreach.
Rare Network claims it has been active in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has operated Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.

The document reports Rare Evo 2025 metrics including 2,500 annual attendance, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social impressions, and 40+ Cardano projects represented.

The document says Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025 was free and publicly accessible, welcomed approximately 500 attendees, and featured governance discussions, technical education, workshops, networking, and a keynote from Charles Hoskinson.

The proposal says selected projects and individuals will use open application processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer participation, and travel/lodging assistance, with selection based on ecosystem contribution and in-person participation value.

The proposal states that sponsorship benefits may change if another sponsor purchases the mainstage or livestream package before approval, with Cardano receiving an equal impact or dollar value sponsorship instead.

The proposer claims the effort aligns with governance, community and ecosystem growth, and ecosystem sustainability by expanding participation, education, onboarding, visibility, and coordination through established event infrastructure.

summary: The proposal seeks ₳2.75M for Rare Network to provide Cardano title sponsorship at Rare Evo 2026 and Dev Gov Day 2026, with event access, booths, programming, travel support, media/livestream exposure, and a claimed VIP ticket revenue return to the treasury.
